notes.title: Summon: Joint escape v1.0.2
notes.content:
Summon: Joint escape v1.0.2

1. Fixed newly discovered player stuck zones.
2. Improved loading when creating a room.
3. Fixed the ability to duplicate collectible items.
4. Slightly modified the game ending.

Thank you to everyone who helps find bugs, your assistance is invaluable! By the way, if you're having issues with Discord, we also have a Telegram group where you can report bugs: https://t.me/goosixgames

notes.title: v1.0.1
notes.content:
[b]Summon: Joint escape v1.0.1[/b]

1. Fixed 3 spots where players could get stuck.
2. Improved optimization in the center of the map (many experienced significant FPS drops in this area).
3. NPCs now patrol the map more frequently.
4. NPCs now spawn more often.
5. Uncle Bogdan's speed has been slightly increased.
